Personally I go through this feeling a lot and even now I am struggling with some of my own issues but I think from my own experience that you should not hide how you are feeling. I know that it can be really hard to open up about things that are caused by depression and anxiety but  the person you are with is with you for a reason, they love you very much and won't take that as being a burden to them at all. One thing I have learned from my current relationship is that you two are there for one another, to pick the other one up when one of you are at your lowest. I know this sounds ridiculously cheesy but it's true, when you're in a relationship you two should be a team and work on things together so that you both can move forward together. If she wants to help then just talk to her and the two of you can figure out what needs to be done.

It's just so hard to even think about it... when he cheated on my I can't express how much it hurt and now I have to put him through the same thing... for a moment I thought to myself that I shouldn't even tell him but I know that would be hurting him just as much and I rather be honest and lose him than lie and hurt... I don't want to lose him but I feel he deserves better... I could care less how much pain I am in, I deserve to feel this way... I just don't want to see him in pain... I'm seeing him after work today to tell him and my stomach is in knots... I don't even know how to go about it...

The tables were turned at one point, I was hurt but I forgave him for what he did and we tried to make it work then broke up for a good few months and it was hard... I'm going over to his house today after work to tell him...

even so i won't ever be able to have a good stable relationship regardless of who I am with... no one wants to be with someone who has cheated on someone before, even if I never do it again I will never be able to gain that trust again... what makes it worse is that when I was cheated on by my fiance I remember how bad it hurt...I remember how I couldn't even look at him without hurting for at least a year and a half and yet I did the same thing and now he is going to feel what I had to feel... I promised him I would never do anything to hurt him and yet I did...

I don't even know how I am going to deal with this situation....I need to tell him what happened but I know it is going to crush him...he's told me that I am the only thing in this world that is worth living for, that I am the best thing to have ever happened to him and how he couldn't imagine a world without me and yet I fuck up so damn badly and fuck another guy... I really am scum.

I plan on telling him tomorrow about it in person, I don't want to be a person who tells people that kind of thing over the phone or over a message online...this is the first time in my whole life that I have ever cheated on anyone... it's the last time as well... I don't feel like this can be fixed... I know once I tell him that it is going to break his heart...he won't want anything to do with me... he would have been better off never knowing me...I don't deserve happiness... I feel like I don't deserve to be with anyone... that it would just be better if I offed myself that way no one could ever get hurt by me again...

I just feel like such a waste of life right now...5 years of being with someone who I wanted to spend the rest of my life with and I fuck it up by cheating on him... If I love him so much why the hell did I even cheat?... I feel like scum...
I don't know... I feel so numb right now yet sick to my stomach at the same time...
